question: I have a diagnosis and my doctor says I should apply for the disability tax credit. Can you confirm that CRA will approve me?
generated_answer: No, we cannot confirm whether CRA will approve your application for the disability tax credit. The decision to approve or deny an application is made by the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) based on the information provided in the application and the criteria set out in the Income Tax Act. It is important to ensure that you provide all the necessary documentation and information required by the CRA when applying for the disability tax credit. If you have any questions or concerns about the application process, you may want to contact the CRA directly or seek advice from a tax professional.
